origem.mcpTitle: The most complete way to migrate: ask an AI agent
origem.mcpBody: Connect Claude or ChatGPT to your Mesaas through MCP and ask something like "migrate my clients and calendar from Notion to Mesaas". The agent reads the data straight from the other tool and creates clients, posts and tasks here, with no file exports needed.

guide.heading: How to export from {{label}}
guide.fullGuide: See the full guide in the Help Center

notion.label: Notion
notion.hint: A single "Markdown & CSV" export (.zip) of the page that lists your clients
steps: In Notion, open the topmost page that holds your client list (the one that shows all of them, not a single client's page).
Click ••• in the top right corner and choose "Export".
Turn on "Include subpages": that is what brings in the databases that live inside the page.
If you see the option to include files and images, choose not to include them. The zip gets smaller and the limit here is 20 MB per file.
Upload the generated .zip here (or the .csv, if you exported a single database).
notes: Export just once, from the top page. There is no need to export client by client.
Only tables and databases (CSV files) are imported. Page text and briefs are not part of this import.

trello.label: Trello
steps: Trello exports one board at a time. Open the board you want to bring in.
Go to Menu → More → Print and export → "Export as JSON".
Save the .json file. Repeat for each board (up to 5 per import).
notes: Have more than 5 boards? Import the first 5 and run the wizard again for the rest.
If you have the CSV export from Trello Premium, use the "Spreadsheet (CSV)" source.

clickup.label: ClickUp
clickup.hint: List export as CSV, one file per list
steps: In ClickUp, open the List (or the Space) you want to bring in.
Click ••• → "Download" (or "Export") and choose CSV, not XLSX.
Repeat for each list (up to 5 per import).
notes: The Excel format (.xlsx) is not accepted. When exporting, choose CSV.

csv.label: Spreadsheet (CSV)
steps: In Google Sheets: File → Download → Comma-separated values (.csv).
In Excel: File → Save As → CSV.
The first row of the file must contain the column titles.

preview.title: Import preview

preview.mergeNote: Clients with the same name as an existing client are merged: we only fill empty fields and never overwrite. Because of that, the merge is not reverted by “Undo import”.

commit.resumeNote: Rows that already went in will not be duplicated: when you try again, we pick up where we left off.
commit.dontClose: Do not close this tab until it finishes.
commit.retryNote: If the cause has been resolved (for example, the plan limit), you can safely try again: we continue the same import, so nothing that already went in is duplicated. Only the rows that failed are written.
commit.retryNotePhone: If the cause has been resolved (for example, the plan limit), you can safely try again: we continue the same import, so nothing that already went in is duplicated. Only the rows that failed are written.
commit.publishedKept: {{counted}}: they were already published on Instagram or TikTok.
commit.workflowsKept: {{counted}}: they still have posts or links created after the import.
commit.templatesKept: {{counted}}: they are still in use by deliveries or custom properties.
commit.clientsKept: {{counted}}: they already have data created outside this import (workflows, ideas, connected accounts).
commit.mergedNeverDeleted: Clients merged into existing records are never deleted.
commit.undoNote: You have 7 days to undo this import. We keep anything that has since come to depend on other things (posts already published, calendars with new content, and clients with data created later) and we list everything that was kept.
